description: This file defines classes and functions for parsing and handling X.509 certificates within the QUIC protocol implementation, including certificate parsing, signature verification, and key management.

classes.name: CertificateView
classes.description: Represents a parsed X.509 certificate, providing methods for parsing, signature verification, and access to certificate details.

classes.name: CertificatePrivateKey
classes.description: Represents a private key associated with an X.509 certificate, supporting loading, signing, and key matching.

methods.name: ParseSingleCertificate
methods.description: Parses a DER-encoded X.509 certificate and returns a CertificateView object or nullptr on error.

methods.name: LoadPemFromStream
methods.description: Loads all PEM-encoded X.509 certificates from an input stream without parsing them.

methods.name: GetHumanReadableSubject
methods.description: Returns a human-readable string of the certificate's subject.

methods.name: VerifySignature
methods.description: Verifies the signature of the certificate data using the specified signature algorithm.

methods.name: public_key_type
methods.description: Returns the type of the public key used in the certificate.

methods.name: LoadPemFromStream
methods.description: Loads a private key from a PEM-formatted input stream.

methods.name: Sign
methods.description: Signs data using the private key with a specified TLS signature algorithm.

methods.name: MatchesPublicKey
methods.description: Checks if the private key matches the public key in a given certificate view.

methods.name: ValidForSignatureAlgorithm
methods.description: Checks if the private key can be used with a specific signature algorithm.
